Class Main

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
application.Main
public class Main extends javafx.application.Application
Main JavaFX application entry for the tower defense game.

This class coordinates high-level runtime flow: menu bootstrapping, transition into an active match, game-loop startup, and synchronization between GameManager state and game UI elements (HUD, shop, status panel, and end-game overlays). It also owns shared scene references used for application-level scene changes such as returning to the main menu.
